items.name: Batch Small Files
items.text: Batch thousands of small files via Glue workflow events (N events/T sec), S3 to SQS batching, or scheduled jobs with bookmarks.

items: S3 Event Notifications cannot target Step Functions or Glue directly; route via EventBridge or Lambda.
EventBridge scheduled rules use UTC only; prefer EventBridge Scheduler for time zones, DST, and one-time runs.
Avoid cron-Lambda S3 polling or Lambda sleep loops; use S3 events, EventBridge, or Step Functions .sync.
Enabling EventBridge on an S3 bucket sends all bucket events to the default bus; rules filter what matters.
